children: Palm oil prices ended lower amid concerns over weak demand following a recent rally, said David Ng, a trader at Kuala Lumpur-based Iceberg X. However, stronger energy prices are capping downward pressure, he said. Ng expects palm oil to face resistance at 5,080 ringgit a ton and find support at 4,900 ringgit a ton. The Bursa Malaysia Derivatives contract for November delivery closed 9 ringgit lower at 4,967 ringgit a ton. (jiahui.huang@wsj.com; @ivy_jiahuihuang)
